business_summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services to individuals, small and medium enterprises, and corporate customers in Brazil and internationally. It operates in two segments, Commercial Banking and Global Wholesale Banking. The company offers payment and loyalty products, including credit and debit cards; payroll and real estate loans; home equity financing solutions; microfinance programs; consortiums; agribusiness products, such as credit, securities and other products; call center and digital solutions; nonperforming assets; and insurance products comprising life, personal accident, vehicle, property, and credit insurance, as well as insurance for travel and banking transactions. It also provides emergency solutions for homes, cars, motorcycles, pets, and telemedicine; consumer finance; and corporate and investment banking services, which include cash management, structured trade and working capital solutions, trade and lending, mergers and acquisitions, equity capital markets, investment grade and emerging markets debt, and structured finance, as well as sales markets, market making, energy trading, equities, research, and private debt mobilization and securitization. In addition, the company offers cash management solutions, such as collections, payments, instant payments, and payroll and custody services; advance program, a non-financial platform to support entrepreneurs regarding educational content, certified courses, events focused on management, innovation, internationalization, and team development; customer funding through deposits and other bank funding instruments; and various investments. It offers its products and services through branches, mini-branches, and automated teller machines; call centers; banking correspondents and third-party vendors; and online and mobile banking platforms. The company was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil.
business_summary_ko: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A.는 자회사와 함께 브라질 및 해외의 개인, 중소기업, 기업 고객에게 다양한 은행 상품과 서비스를 제공합니다. 상업 금융과 글로벌 도매 금융이라는 두 부문으로 운영됩니다. 회사는 신용카드와 직불카드를 포함한 결제 및 로열티 상품을 제공합니다. 급여 및 부동산 대출; 주택 담보 금융 솔루션; 소액금융 프로그램; 컨소시엄; 신용, 증권 및 기타 제품과 같은 농업 관련 제품; 콜센터 및 디지털 솔루션; 부실자산 생명보험, 개인상해보험, 차량보험, 재산보험, 신용보험, 여행보험, 은행거래 보험 등으로 구성되는 보험상품입니다. 또한 가정, 자동차, 오토바이, 애완동물 및 원격 의료를 위한 응급 솔루션도 제공합니다. 소비자 금융; 현금 관리, 구조화 무역 및 운전 자본 솔루션, 무역 및 대출, 인수 및 합병, 자기자본 시장, 투자 등급 및 신흥 시장 부채, 구조화 금융뿐만 아니라 판매 시장, 시장 조성, 에너지 거래, 주식, 재화 등을 포함하는 기업 및 투자 금융 서비스
